title: Polyphyllin I induced ferroptosis to suppress the progression of hepatocellular carcinoma through activation of the mitochondrial dysfunction via Nrf2/HO-1/GPX4 axis.
authors: Yang, Renyi; Gao, Wenhui; Wang, Zhibing; Jian, Huiying; Peng, Lian; Yu, Xiaopeng; Xue, Peisen; Peng, Wei; Li, Kexiong; Zeng, Puhua
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药单体Polyphyllin I通过Nrf2/HO-1/GPX4轴诱导肝癌细胞铁死亡，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Ferroptosis is an emerging iron-dependent programmed cell death mode characterized by lipid peroxidation and iron accumulation, closely associated with Hepatocellular Carcinoma (HCC) progression. Although the impact of Polyphyllin I (PPI), a prominent bioactive constituent derived from Paris polyphylla, on diverse malignancies has been established, the specific role and potential mechanistic pathways through which PPI modulates ferroptosis in HCC remain elusive. PURPOSE: This study aimed to elucidate the anti-cancer properties and potential mechanisms of PPI in inducing ferroptosis and triggering mitochondrial injury in HCC. METHODS: Cell viability was assessed using CCK-8 assays. EdU proliferation and colony formation assays were employed to evaluate cell proliferation. A wound-healing assay was performed to assess cell migration. Transwell assay was utilized to evaluate cell invasion. Ferroptosis was evaluated through the utilization of a FerroOrange fluorescent probe, malondialdehyde (MDA) and reduced glutathione (GSH) assay kits, DCFH-DA fluorescent probe, western blotting, and transmission electron microscopy (TEM) analysis. Molecular docking, immunofluorescence, and western blotting were employed to predict and validate the binding and interaction of PPI with Nrf2, HO-1, xCT, and GPX4. Mitochondrial structure and membrane potential changes were evaluated using JC-1 and Mito Tracker Green fluorescent probes. A nude mice xenograft model was constructed to determine the inhibitory effects and the levels of ferroptosis of PPI on HCC through hematoxylin and eosin (H&E), Prussian blue reaction, immunofluorescence staining, immunohistochemistry, and western blotting analysis, in vivo. RESULTS: PPI exhibited dose-dependent inhibitory effects on the proliferation, invasion, and metastasis of HCC cells mediated by increasing reactive oxygen species (ROS) and MDA levels, promoting Fe(2+) accumulation, depleting GSH, and suppressing the expression of xCT and GPX4, thereby inducing ferroptosis in HCC. The induction of ferroptosis by PPI was associated with the binding of PPI to Nrf2, HO-1, and GPX4 proteins, modulating the Nrf2/HO-1/GPX4 antioxidant axis. PPI also induced mitochondrial structural damage and decreased mitochondrial membrane potential (MMP). Inhibition of ferroptosis by ferrostatin-1 (Fer-1) mitigated the mitochondrial disruption induced by PPI. In vivo, PPI inhibited Nrf2/HO-1/GPX4 axis-induced ferroptosis, impeding HCC growth similar to the effects of sorafenib. CONCLUSION: These results demonstrated that PPI intervention can suppress the proliferation, invasion, and metastasis of HCC cells by enhancing mitochondrial disruption and inducing ferroptosis via the Nrf2/HO-1/GPX4 axis. Consequently, our research advances the frontiers of pharmacodynamics and deepens our comprehension of the intricate mechanisms underpinning PPI. Furthermore, it has yielded an innovative treatment stratagem rooted in the tenets of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM), thereby furnishing a novel therapeutic avenue for addressing HCC.
abstract_zh: 背景：铁死亡（ferroptosis）是一种新兴的铁依赖性程序性细胞死亡模式，以脂质过氧化和铁积累为特征，与肝细胞癌（Hepatocellular Carcinoma, HCC）的进展密切相关。尽管重楼皂苷I（Polyphyllin I, PPI）作为重楼（Paris polyphylla）中一种重要的生物活性成分，其对多种恶性肿瘤的影响已得到证实，但PPI在HCC中调节铁死亡的具体作用及潜在机制途径仍不明确。目的：本研究旨在阐明PPI在诱导HCC铁死亡和触发线粒体损伤中的抗癌特性及潜在机制。方法：使用CCK-8实验评估细胞活力。采用EdU增殖和集落形成实验评估细胞增殖。进行伤口愈合实验评估细胞迁移。利用Transwell实验评估细胞侵袭。通过FerroOrange荧光探针、丙二醛（malondialdehyde, MDA）和还原型谷胱甘肽（reduced glutathione, GSH）检测试剂盒、DCFH-DA荧光探针、蛋白质印迹法（western blotting）和透射电子显微镜（transmission electron microscopy, TEM）分析评估铁死亡。采用分子对接、免疫荧光和蛋白质印迹法预测并验证PPI与Nrf2、HO-1、xCT和GPX4的结合及相互作用。使用JC-1和Mito Tracker Green荧光探针评估线粒体结构和膜电位变化。构建裸鼠异种移植瘤模型，通过苏木精-伊红染色（hematoxylin and eosin, H&E）、普鲁士蓝反应、免疫荧光染色、免疫组织化学和蛋白质印迹分析，在体内确定PPI对HCC的抑制作用及铁死亡水平。结果：PPI对HCC细胞的增殖、侵袭和转移表现出剂量依赖性抑制作用，其机制为增加活性氧（reactive oxygen species, ROS）和MDA水平、促进Fe(2+)积累、耗竭GSH，并抑制xCT和GPX4的表达，从而诱导HCC铁死亡。PPI诱导的铁死亡与其结合Nrf2、HO-1和GPX4蛋白相关，调节Nrf2/HO-1/GPX4抗氧化轴。PPI还诱导线粒体结构损伤并降低线粒体膜电位（mitochondrial membrane potential, MMP）。铁死亡抑制剂ferrostatin-1（Fer-1）可缓解PPI诱导的线粒体破坏。在体内，PPI抑制Nrf2/HO-1/GPX4轴诱导的铁死亡，阻碍HCC生长，其效果与索拉非尼（sorafenib）相似。结论：这些结果表明，PPI干预可通过Nrf2/HO-1/GPX4轴增强线粒体破坏并诱导铁死亡，从而抑制HCC细胞的增殖、侵袭和转移。因此，我们的研究推进了药效学前沿，并加深了对PPI复杂机制的理解。此外，它基于传统中医药（Traditional Chinese Medicine, TCM）原则产生了一种创新治疗策略，为应对HCC提供了新的治疗途径。
